description: §14.8.10 (S456) — control for E-TENANT-UNDECLARED: a program-body `?{CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (id, msg)}` (no `tenant_id`) beside a `<schema>`-declared tenant table compiles; the declared table's read is filtered at the source.
rationale: §14.8.10: E-TENANT-UNDECLARED charges only a table that carries a `tenant_id` column outside the compilation's tenant set; a table without `tenant_id` is not tenant data.
